source: keep-track PRs #36, #38 and #39; all 1,767 pairs, one trial per row. Plain rows: the paper's zero-shot prompt through the paper-prompt runner, low reasoning effort, one call per pair; plain gpt-5.4-mini ran at 09e04c8 (PR #31), plain gpt-5.6-sol at a5d647a (PR #39). Pipeline rows: the zero-shot search, word price at edit budget 8, 8 submissions, ranked over the offered labels plus no relation with 5 shuffles; the gpt-5.4-mini search is the November 20 zero-shot search at e8c2b18, ranked at 8bb3fe7 with typed claims and at e8c2b18 with LLM readings (PR #32); the gpt-5.6-sol search and ranking ran at a5d647a with gpt-5.6-sol for every call.
bootstrap: compare.py in keep-track-proof-readings-20261121 on rolly: paired over pairs, 2,000 resamples drawn with random.Random(20261103).randrange; [point, 2.5th, 97.5th percentile]
tuning: no held-out pairs: the proved arm went through four full gpt-5.4-mini runs on these pairs, relation F1 69.8, 77.5, 78.0, then 78.4 at 8bb3fe7, the typed claims row here; its ranker sees typed claims from the third run (7a4c59f), and the second ran from a working-tree stash of e724925's change (11c2f50), which also changed the arm's pick of each label's candidate; the guideline ranker's prompt was revised twice, each time after a ranking that left out an option stopped the run (1,616 pairs at f0f1da5, then 1,509 at 59788b7 with two shards rerun), and its row is its first complete run, at 8bb3fe7; both were also piloted on 65 of these pairs, the proved arm, in its first two versions, over this search and over PR #37's search, the guideline one over this search only, and a third arm, both-readings-none, was piloted twice and dropped; gpt-5.6-sol ran the typed claims ranker's final prompt once; the plain prompt was not revised
not isolated: the pipeline-over-plain comparison does not isolate the proofs: on gpt-5.6-sol the pipeline made 34,047 completions (26,477 search, 7,570 ranking) against plain's 1,767, and no arm gives plain prompting a second look against no relation
failures: plain gpt-5.4-mini has 8 replies without a valid label, the other rows none. FAILURE is a reply that gave no valid label; it is scored as the harness scores it, a missed gold relation and never a false positive
gpt-5.6-sol search: stopped after 365 pairs by a provider rate-limit error; the other 1,402 pairs were searched with the same settings and the two traces joined before ranking, so each pair's trace is one finished per-pair search, from one of the two runs, and was ranked once; up to 12 pairs in flight when it stopped (12 workers) were searched again from scratch, and their aborted calls are not in the search usage
